content: Section 8 of the Standards of Care in Diabetes–2024 focuses on obesity and weight management as critical components in the prevention and treatment of type 2 diabetes. It emphasizes the importance of addressing excess body weight to improve glycemic control, reduce the risk of diabetes-related complications, and enhance overall metabolic health. The section provides evidence-based recommendations for healthcare professionals to guide patients in achieving and maintaining a healthy weight through a combination of lifestyle interventions, pharmacotherapy, and, in some cases, metabolic surgery. It highlights the role of individualized care plans tailored to the patient's specific needs, preferences, and medical history.
